tools.name: get_shop_overview
tools.description: Facts about LivaGlow and its single product, the personalised ceramic mug: specs, fixed prices, volume discount, shipping (Germany only), delivery, returns policy, photo requirements and key URLs. For a quote use calculate_price, for delivery dates use get_delivery_estimate.

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what one or more mugs cost, with or without shipping. Exact price in EUR: first mug full price, every additional mug discounted (also across different designs), shipping cost or free shipping, total. Same maths as the shop checkout, before any promo code.

tools.name: get_delivery_estimate
tools.description: Use this when the user asks when a mug would arrive. Expected delivery window for an order placed now (Germany, DPD, UPS or DHL): production start rule (cutoff 14:00 Berlin time on business days), earliest and latest delivery date, plus the current workload (normal / elevated / high) with the estima

tools.name: list_occasions
tools.description: Occasion landing pages with ready-made templates (photo mug, birthday, couples, pet, Mother's Day, Christmas) with German and English URLs and the designer deep link that preselects the templates.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Keyword search over the shop FAQ and the occasion-page FAQs (German): designer usage, image quality, payment, shipping and shipping countries, returns, care. Returns the best matching questions with full answers.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find LivaGlow guide articles (German) about printed mugs: dishwasher safety, porcelain vs ceramic, photo resolution, printing costs, print durability, gift ideas. Returns title, direct answer and URL.

tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Full content of a LivaGlow page as Markdown. Supported paths: /, /custom, /faq, /ratgeber, /ratgeber/:slug, /tasse/:slug, /mug/:slug, /vorlagen, /vorlagen/:slug, /produktsicherheit, /partnerprogramm, /partnerprogramm/:slug, /presse, /status (e.g. /faq, /ratgeber/tasse-spuelmaschinenfest, /tasse/gebu

tools.name: get_store_rating
tools.description: Current Trustpilot rating of the shop (TrustScore and number of reviews) with the profile URL.

tools.name: get_design_options
tools.description: Everything an agent needs before create_design_link: available fonts with style hints, text size range, background presets, photo shapes, clipart ids by category, templates with their text slots, print-area geometry and limits.

tools.name: create_design_link
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a mug designed or personalised. Turns a design description into a link that opens the LivaGlow designer with the finished draft (texts, cliparts, background, photo placeholder, optional template). If the user already gave a text or an occasion, build the draft with sensi

tools.name: get_care_and_safety
tools.description: Whether the mug and its print are dishwasher and microwave safe, plus care instructions and safety warnings (thermal shock, damage) as published on the product safety page.
